extDescription.message: Make X readable: locally blur or hide noisy replies, timeline posts, and ads; optional page cleanups; no cookies or account changes.

filter_effect_hint.message: Choose whether matched replies or posts are blurred or hidden.

account_source_link.message: View public data and audit history

account_blacklist_hint.message: Local account blacklist. Enter one numeric X ID or @handle per line.

account_whitelist_hint.message: Local account whitelist. It overrides every blacklist.

rule_export_description.message: Download your custom keyword and account rules as a backup file.

rule_import_description.message: Restore custom keyword and account rules from a BlueNoise backup file.

rule_import_success_replace.message: Rules replaced successfully. Ignored $1 invalid rules.

rule_import_mode_merge_description.message: Keep existing rules and add only non-duplicate rules.

rule_import_mode_append_description.message: Keep existing rules and append every valid rule, including duplicates.

my_keywords_hint.message: Add words or regular expressions that should trigger filtering. Use one rule per line.

whitelist_hint.message: Replies or posts matching these rules are never filtered. Use one rule per line.

theme_hint.message: Choose how the extension looks in light and dark environments.

about_intro_after_platform.message: , right in your browser. Set the rules, then get back to what you came for.

about_idea_title.message: A feed with room to think

about_idea_body_after_platform.message: is full of information, but too much of it competes for your attention. BlueNoise lets you decide what stays visible. Your rules and data remain in your browser. It never touches your account, calls the

about_name_body.message: Blue noise is used in image and signal processing. It spreads interference out instead of letting it collect in distracting patches. That is the idea here. A good feed still has surprise and disagreement; it just does not need to keep asking for your attention with repetition, bait, and clutter.

about_open_body.message: BlueNoise is open source. You can read the code, ask questions, or help improve it. An extension should earn your trust by making its behavior easy to inspect, not by asking you to take its word for it.

about_studio_body.message: Coryso Studio is an independent product studio. We make focused digital tools that fit the way people actually work. BlueNoise is one of them. Visit us to see what else we are building.

filter_media_ads_hint.message: Blur or hide promoted posts with video or image media.

filter_card_ads_hint.message: Blur or hide promoted posts containing a website card.

debug_logging_hint.message: Write filtering diagnostics to the DevTools console of the page being filtered.
